# Forage New Zealand

> A free guide to wild food in New Zealand: which wild plants are in season in each region and month, how to recognise and harvest them, the dangerous lookalikes to avoid, and 35 dishes to cook with them.

Seasons and ranges are approximate. Every plant should be confirmed with an experienced local forager before eating.

- [App](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nz/): pick a region and month to see what is wild near you
- [All wild plants](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nz/plants/)
- [All dishes](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nz/dishes/)

## Wild plants

- [Kawakawa](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nz/plants/kawakawa/): Piper excelsum; Kawakawa. In season all year round.
- [Pūhā](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nz/plants/puha/): Sonchus oleraceus; Pūhā, Sow thistle. In season all year round.
- [Pikopiko](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nz/plants/pikopiko/): Asplenium bulbiferum; Pikopiko, Hen and chickens fern. In season August to November.
- [Kōkihi](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nz/plants/kokihi/): Tetragonia tetragonioides; Kōkihi, NZ spinach. In season October to April.
- [Horopito](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nz/plants/horopito/): Pseudowintera colorata; Horopito, Pepper tree. In season all year round.
- [Karengo](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nz/plants/karengo/): Pyropia; Karengo, Nori. In season July to November.
- [Kōuka](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nz/plants/kouka/): Cordyline australis; Kōuka, Cabbage tree. In season August to November.
- [Supplejack shoots](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nz/plants/supplejack/): Ripogonum scandens; Kareao, Supplejack. In season September to December.
- [Kōnini](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nz/plants/konini/): Fuchsia excorticata; Kōnini, Tree fuchsia. In season December to March.
- [Watercress](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nz/plants/watercress/): Nasturtium officinale; Watercress, Wātakirihi. In season August to December.
- [Three-cornered leek](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nz/plants/onionweed/): Allium triquetrum; Onion weed, Three-cornered garlic. In season June to October.
- [Mānuka](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nz/plants/manuka/): Leptospermum scoparium; Mānuka, Tea tree. In season all year round.
- [Elderflower](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nz/plants/elderflower/): Sambucus nigra; Elderflower. In season November to December.
- [Elderberry](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nz/plants/elderberry/): Sambucus nigra; Elderberry. In season February to March.
- [Blackberry](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nz/plants/blackberry/): Rubus fruticosus; Blackberry. In season January to March.
- [Dandelion](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nz/plants/dandelion/): Taraxacum officinale; Dandelion. In season August to April.
- [Chickweed](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nz/plants/chickweed/): Stellaria media; Chickweed. In season April to November.
- [Stinging nettle](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nz/plants/nettle/): Urtica dioica; Stinging nettle. In season August to November.
- [Rose hips](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nz/plants/rosehip/): Rosa canina; Rose hips. In season March to May.
- [Wild fennel](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nz/plants/fennel/): Foeniculum vulgare; Wild fennel. In season September to February.
- [Pipi and tuatua](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nz/plants/pipi/): Paphies australis; Pipi, Tuatua. In season all year round.
- [Karamū berries](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nz/plants/karamu/): Coprosma robusta; Karamū berries. In season March to May.
- [Kiekie fruit](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nz/plants/kiekie/): Freycinetia banksii; Kiekie fruit. In season February to April.
- [Tawa berries](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nz/plants/tawa/): Beilschmiedia tawa; Tawa berries. In season February to April.
- [Native celery](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nz/plants/nzcelery/): Apium prostratum; Native celery. In season all year round.
- [Nasturtium](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nz/plants/nasturtium/): Tropaeolum majus; Nasturtium. In season all year round.
- [Sea lettuce](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nz/plants/sealettuce/): Ulva; Sea lettuce. In season September to April.
- [Harakeke nectar](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nz/plants/harakeke/): Phormium tenax; Harakeke nectar. In season October to December.
- [Wild plums](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nz/plants/wildplum/): Prunus cerasifera; Wild plums. In season December to February.
- [Hawthorn](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nz/plants/hawthornnz/): Crataegus monogyna; Hawthorn. In season March to May.
- [Walnut](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nz/plants/walnutnz/): Juglans regia; Walnut. In season March to May.
- [Sweet chestnut](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nz/plants/chestnutnz/): Castanea sativa; Sweet chestnut. In season March to May.
- [Kina](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nz/plants/kina/): Evechinus chloroticus; Kina. In season June to October.
- [Pāua](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nz/plants/paua/): Haliotis iris; Pāua. In season all year round.
- [Tuangi cockles](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nz/plants/cockle/): Austrovenus stutchburyi; Tuangi cockles. In season all year round.
- [Green-lipped mussels](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nz/plants/mussel/): Perna canaliculus; Green-lipped mussels. In season all year round.
- [Poroporo](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nz/plants/poroporo/): Solanum aviculare; Poroporo. In season December to April.
- [Kānuka tea](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nz/plants/kanuka/): Kunzea robusta; Kānuka tea. In season all year round.
- [Feijoa](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nz/plants/feijoa/): Acca sellowiana; Feijoa. In season March to June.
- [Cherry guava](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nz/plants/cherryguava/): Psidium cattleianum; Cherry guava. In season February to May.
- [Hazelnut](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nz/plants/hazelnut/): Corylus avellana; Hazelnut. In season February to April.
- [Oysters](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nz/plants/oyster/): Ostrea edulis / Magallana gigas; Oysters, Tio. In season March to August.
- [Rimurapa · Bull kelp](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nz/plants/rimurapa/): Durvillaea antarctica; Rimurapa, Bull kelp. In season all year round.
- [Hakeka · Wood ear](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nz/plants/hakeka/): Auricularia cornea; Hakeka, Wood ear. In season all year round.
- [Saffron milk cap](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nz/plants/saffronmilkcap/): Lactarius deliciosus / L. deterrimus; Saffron milk cap, Pine mushroom. In season March to May.
- [Slippery jack](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nz/plants/slipperyjack/): Suillus luteus; Slippery jack. In season March to June.
- [Field mushroom](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nz/plants/fieldmushroom/): Agaricus campestris; Field mushroom. In season February to April.
- [Porcini](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nz/plants/porcini/): Boletus edulis; Porcini, Cep. In season March to May.
- [Shaggy inkcap](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nz/plants/shaggymane/): Coprinus comatus; Shaggy inkcap. In season March to June.
- [Ribwort plantain](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nz/plants/plantain/): Plantago lanceolata; Ribwort plantain. In season September to April.
- [Common mallow](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nz/plants/mallow/): Malva sylvestris; Common mallow. In season September to April.
- [Fat hen](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nz/plants/fathen/): Chenopodium album; Fat hen. In season November to March.
- [Cleavers](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nz/plants/cleavers/): Galium aparine; Cleavers. In season August to November.
- [Gorse flowers](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nz/plants/gorse/): Ulex europaeus; Gorse flowers. In season July to November.
- [Cherry plum](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nz/plants/cherryplum/): Prunus cerasifera; Cherry plum, Wild plum. In season December to February.
- [Raupō](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nz/plants/raupo/): Typha orientalis; Raupō. In season November to January.
- [Hīnau](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nz/plants/hinau/): Elaeocarpus dentatus; Hīnau. In season February to May.
- [Kahikatea berries](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nz/plants/kahikatea/): Dacrycarpus dacrydioides; Kahikatea berries. In season March to May.

## Dishes

- [Kawakawa tea](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nz/dishes/kawakawa-tea/): Holey kawakawa leaves steeped in hot water, a traditional rongoā drink.
- [Mānuka tea](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nz/dishes/m-nuka-tea/): A few mānuka leaves steeped in hot water.
- [Elderflower cordial](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nz/dishes/elderflower-cordial/): Flowers steeped with lemon and citric acid, sweetened.
- [Pipi fritters](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nz/dishes/pipi-fritters/): Minced pipi in an egg and flour batter, fried golden.
- [Pikopiko in butter](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nz/dishes/pikopiko-in-butter/): Blanched fern fronds sautéed with butter and garlic.
- [Steamed kōuka](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nz/dishes/steamed-k-uka/): Cabbage tree shoot hearts steamed and buttered.
- [Horopito salt](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nz/dishes/horopito-salt/): Dried horopito ground with sea salt for meat and eggs.
- [Kawakawa pesto](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nz/dishes/kawakawa-pesto/): Kawakawa leaves blended with oil and nuts.
- [Blackberry jam](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nz/dishes/blackberry-jam/): Late-summer blackberries cooked with sugar.
- [Pork and pūhā boil-up](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nz/dishes/pork-and-p-h-boil-up/): Pork bones, potatoes, kūmara and pūhā or watercress simmered with dumplings.
- [Karengo broth](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nz/dishes/karengo-broth/): Seaweed simmered into a savoury broth with fish.
- [Nettle soup](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nz/dishes/nettle-soup/): Nettle tops with potato, blended.
- [Horopito fry bread (parāoa parai)](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nz/dishes/horopito-fry-bread/): Fried bread dough with a pinch of ground horopito.
- [Kōnini jam on scones](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nz/dishes/k-nini-jam-on-scones/): Tree fuchsia berries cooked into jam.
- [Harakeke nectar water](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nz/dishes/harakeke-nectar-water/): Flax flowers shaken into water for a sweet traditional drink.
- [Elderberry syrup](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nz/dishes/elderberry-syrup/): Late-summer elderberries cooked with honey and spice.
- [Pāua fritters](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nz/dishes/p-ua-fritters/): Minced pāua in egg batter, fried.
- [Kina on toast](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nz/dishes/kina-on-toast/): Fresh kina roe on buttered bread.
- [Steamed tuangi with kawakawa](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nz/dishes/steamed-tuangi-with-kawakawa/): Cockles steamed with kawakawa and butter.
- [Pickled nasturtium capers](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nz/dishes/pickled-nasturtium-capers/): Green nasturtium seeds pickled like capers.
- [Wild plum sauce](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nz/dishes/wild-plum-sauce/): Plums cooked with spices into a sauce for meat.
- [Green-lipped mussel chowder](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nz/dishes/green-lipped-mussel-chowder/): Creamy chowder with green-lipped mussels and native celery.
- [Watercress and pork boil-up](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nz/dishes/watercress-and-pork-boil-up/): Pork bones, potatoes and watercress, the Waikato way.
- [Kiekie fruit (tāwhara)](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nz/dishes/kiekie-fruit/): The sweet bracts eaten fresh in spring.
- [Blackberry crumble](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nz/dishes/blackberry-crumble/): Blackberries under an oat crumble.
- [Feijoa crumble](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nz/dishes/feijoa-crumble/): Scooped feijoa pulp under a buttery oat crumble.
- [Feijoa chutney](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nz/dishes/feijoa-chutney/): Feijoas, onion, ginger and vinegar cooked into chutney.
- [Kānuka tea](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nz/dishes/k-nuka-tea/): Fresh kānuka leaves steeped in hot water.
- [Poroporo jam](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nz/dishes/poroporo-jam/): Fully ripe orange poroporo cooked into jam.
- [Pine mushrooms on toast](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nz/dishes/pine-mushrooms-on-toast/): Saffron milk caps fried in butter on toast.
- [Wood ear stir-fry](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nz/dishes/wood-ear-stir-fry/): Hakeka with pork, ginger and spring onion.
- [Oysters with lemon](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nz/dishes/oysters-with-lemon/): Freshly shucked oysters with lemon.
- [Pungapunga (raupō pollen cake)](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nz/dishes/pungapunga/): Golden raupō pollen mixed with water and steamed or baked.
- [Gorse flower cordial](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nz/dishes/gorse-flower-cordial/): Coconut-scented cordial from gorse blossom.
- [Cherry guava jelly](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nz/dishes/cherry-guava-jelly/): Cherry guavas cooked and strained into jelly.
